llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed, read-only VMware Log Insight integration, with expected local credential and audit-log handling.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads potentially sensitive centralized logs and alert history from a configured appliance, which is expected for the purpose and disclosed; the docs recommend TLS verification and read-only service accounts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill installs a uv package and allows Bash so the agent can run the documented CLI/MCP entry points; this is proportionate, but users are still trusting that package and its dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions clearly scope when to use the skill, when not to use it, and how to keep queries bounded; no hidden role changes, unsafe automatic execution, or unrelated tasks were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Credentials may be stored in a local .env file and calls are recorded in a local shared audit database; both behaviors are disclosed and purpose-aligned, with chmod guidance, but they create local sensitive state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is searching and aggregating VMware Aria Operations for Logs data, and the documented tool set is limited to read-only log, metadata, and alert-query operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving the package read access to VMware Log Insight data. Use a read-only service account, keep ~/.vmware-log-insight/.env chmod 600 or inject secrets from a secret manager, leave TLS verification on except for controlled labs, and treat ~/.vmware/audit.db as sensitive local operational history.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: The .env/password handling is expected for authenticating to a configured Log Insight appliance and is disclosed; the artifact also warns that b64 is only obfuscation and recommends secret-manager injection for real at-rest secrecy.
[RA2] expected: The audit DB is disclosed as local accountability logging for tool calls, not hidden persistence or background control; users should still protect it because it can retain operational query metadata.
